name: VLS-TS Salarié (standard employed work visa)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a job offer from a French employer, below the Passeport Talent salary threshold.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a French employer.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires either passing the opposabilité de la situation de l'emploi (labour-market test showing no suitable candidate already present in the French/EU labour market was available), or the occupation appearing on a shortage-occupation list that exempts the employer from the test.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm whether the occupation is on a shortage list, or complete the labour-market test process.

sources.title: Légifrance — CESEDA, carte de séjour temporaire mention salarié

notes: The labour-market test (opposabilité de la situation de l'emploi) remains a real, active gate for standard employed work — the same structural pattern flagged on Spain's cuenta ajena route (situación nacional de empleo). This is the route someone falls back to if their salary doesn't clear the Passeport Talent Salarié Qualifié threshold (€39,582) — worth surfacing as the practical 'what if I don't qualify for Talent' comparison. Requires annual renewal at the préfecture, unlike Passeport Talent's 4-year card — a real quality-of-life difference (more frequent bureaucratic touchpoints) worth flagging distinctly, especially given France's well-documented préfecture appointment backlogs affecting renewal timelines.
